name: Senator Aris or Corporate Rep

greeting.stranger: I represent important interests. Perhaps we can help each other.
greeting.acquaintance: You've been useful. I have another task for you.
greeting.friend: My friend, you understand how politics works. I appreciate that.
greeting.confidant: You've become a valuable ally. Together, we can accomplish great things.

questRelated.centralis_side_02_senate_lobbying: The Assembly is voting on an important bill. My... constituents have a strong interest in the outcome. I need someone to help influence the vote. It's all perfectly legal—just some strategic conversations, a few favors called in. The Concord runs on relationships, and I need someone who understands that. Can you help me ensure the right outcome?

general: Politics is about relationships. Build the right relationships, and you can accomplish anything.
The Assembly is a machine. You just need to know which buttons to push.
Every vote matters. Every relationship matters.
The Concord is still finding its way. We can help shape it.
Credits make the galaxy go round. But influence makes it go round faster.

appearance.distinguishingFeatures: Expensive clothing, polished appearance, confident smile, always networking

biography: This NPC can represent either a Concord senator or a Corporate Sector representative, depending on player choices. They're a skilled politician/lobbyist who understands how the Assembly works and how to influence votes. They're not necessarily corrupt—they're just pragmatic about how politics works. They represent the gray area between legitimate political influence and corruption, and they offer players a chance to engage with the political system.
